Overview

Terre Haute is a city in IN with a population of 60,000. Wabash Valley city with Indiana State University, Rose-Hulman, and historic architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.6.
